It's not as simple as "hey AI, make this game for me." Plenty of game devs do not use AI, and even if most did, it doesn't change the fact that plenty of people want to avoid it. Using it for art means relying on art theft. #3
Chabibi View Profile View Posts Oct 30 @ 12:34pm Report this post Originally posted by poke_k : Plenty of game devs do not use AI, and even if most did, it doesn't change the fact that plenty of people want to avoid it. Using it for art means relying on art theft. My sentiments exactly. Only here by chance, was kind of curious as to how many other of these kind of games the publisher had pushed out (and there was one other, think it had some cat on the image). Also found out that I'd played another game by the devs (The Fall), and had its sequel on my wishlist. Now kinda glad I happened to click, saved me from giving money to devs who'd rather pump out clearly AI stuff, over spending time honing something unique. Unwishlisted the sequel. #4
